news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹36.30 (up from ₹20.25 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹22.0b (up 92% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹2.06b (up 80% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 9.3% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue missed analyst estimates by 8.0%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 4.2%. Revenue is forecast to grow 25% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 7.5% growth forecast for the Tech industry in Asia.

news.title: Netweb Technologies India Limited Recommends Final Dividend
news.body: The Board of Directors of Netweb Technologies India Limited at their meeting held May 2, 2026, recommended a final Dividend of INR 3 per Equity Share on the face value of INR 2 per share (150% of face value), subject to shareholder approval at the ensuing Annual General Meeting.

news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 4 experienced directors. 4 highly experienced directors. Independent & Non–Executive Director Mrutyunjay Mahapatra was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2023. The company’s insufficient board refreshment is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.
